intro: Viking 1 touched down in Chryse Planitia on July 20, 1976 — the first successful US lander on Mars, exactly seven years after Apollo 11. Its 2,307-sol surface mission (6.3 years) included the first colour images from Mars, the first in-situ biology experiments (with ambiguous results), and a daily weather record. Final transmission November 1982 after a command upload accidentally overwrote the antenna-pointing parameters.
